grammar.explanation: 比 introduces the reference B: 图书馆比商场安静 compares the library with the shopping centre. Keep the adjective after both A and B. Do not add 很 before that adjective in this simple comparison. State the same attribute for both things; 比 does not mean every attribute is better.

examples.py: tú shū guǎn bǐ shāng chǎng ān jìng .
examples.en: The library is quieter than the shopping centre.

examples.py: zuò chē bǐ zǒu lù kuài .
examples.en: Taking a vehicle is faster than walking.

commonMistakes.why: Do not insert 很 in this basic 比 comparison.

grammar.pattern: A 比 B + adjective · A 没有 B + adjective
grammar.purpose: Keep the direction of a comparison clear
grammar.explanation: A 比 B 快 means A is faster than B. A 没有 B 快 means A is not as fast as B. It does not mean A lacks B. This negative comparison differs from A不比B快, which need not assert that A is slower; here practise 没有. Compare objects on a relevant shared attribute.

examples.py: zǒu lù méi yǒu zuò chē kuài .
examples.en: Walking is not as fast as taking a vehicle.

examples.py: shāng chǎng méi yǒu tú shū guǎn ān jìng .
examples.en: The shopping centre is not as quiet as the library.

commonMistakes.why: Put 没有 between A and B for not-as comparison.

dialogue.title: Quiet, close, and open
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the place they choose and the alternative they reject.

lines.zh: 今天去商场还是图书馆？
lines.py: jīn tiān qù shāng chǎng hái shi tú shū guǎn ?
lines.en: The shopping centre or the library today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 图书馆比商场安静，我想读书。
lines.py: tú shū guǎn bǐ shāng chǎng ān jìng , wǒ xiǎng dú shū .
lines.en: The library is quieter than the shopping centre; I would like to read.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你住在哪里？图书馆远吗？
lines.py: nǐ zhù zài nǎ lǐ ? tú shū guǎn yuǎn ma ?
lines.en: Where do you live? Is the library far?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我住在教学楼旁边。走路很慢，坐车快一点。
lines.py: wǒ zhù zài jiào xué lóu páng biān . zǒu lù hěn màn , zuò chē kuài yī diǎn .
lines.en: I live beside the teaching building. Walking is slow; taking a vehicle is a little faster.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天雨大，外面的地很湿。坐车吧。
lines.py: jīn tiān yǔ dà , wài miàn de dì hěn shī . zuò chē ba .
lines.en: The rain is heavy and the ground outside is wet. Let us take a vehicle.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。我很渴，先在商店买水，再去图书馆。
lines.py: xíng . wǒ hěn kě , xiān zài shāng diàn mǎi shuǐ , zài qù tú shū guǎn .
lines.en: Okay. I am thirsty; first buy water at the shop, then go to the library.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这家饭店的菜好吃，要先吃饭吗？
lines.py: zhè jiā fàn diàn de cài hǎo chī , yào xiān chī fàn ma ?
lines.en: This restaurant has tasty food. Shall we eat first?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我去过一次。它没有图书馆安静，先读书吧。
lines.py: wǒ qù guò yī cì . tā méi yǒu tú shū guǎn ān jìng , xiān dú shū ba .
lines.en: I have been once. It is not as quiet as the library; let us read first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 朋友今天请假，是生病了吗？
lines.py: péng you jīn tiān qǐng jià , shì shēng bìng le ma ?
lines.en: Our friend took leave today. Is she ill?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，病人在家休息，我们不用等她。
lines.py: duì , bìng rén zài jiā xiū xī , wǒ men bù yòng děng tā .
lines.en: Yes, she is resting at home; we do not need to wait for her.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 学校明天放假，教学楼不开门。图书馆呢？
lines.py: xué xiào míng tiān fàng jià , jiào xué lóu bù kāi mén . tú shū guǎn ne ?
lines.en: The school has a holiday tomorrow and the teaching building is closed. What about the library?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 明天不知道。今天开门，我们今天去。
lines.py: míng tiān bù zhī dào . jīn tiān kāi mén , wǒ men jīn tiān qù .
lines.en: I do not know about tomorrow. It is open today, so we will go today.
lines.speaker: b

choices: The shopping centre for an exam

questions.q: Why discuss opening rather than assume tomorrow is suitable?
choices: A school holiday may affect access
questions.answer: A school holiday may affect access

lines.zh: 我住在教学楼旁边，今天想去图书馆。
lines.py: wǒ zhù zài jiào xué lóu páng biān , jīn tiān xiǎng qù tú shū guǎn .
lines.en: I live beside the teaching building and would like to go to the library today.

lines.zh: 图书馆比商场安静，商场里人多。
lines.py: tú shū guǎn bǐ shāng chǎng ān jìng , shāng chǎng lǐ rén duō .
lines.en: The library is quieter than the shopping centre; the shopping centre is crowded.

lines.zh: 我去过一次旁边的饭店，菜好吃，可是没有图书馆安静。
lines.py: wǒ qù guò yī cì páng biān de fàn diàn , cài hǎo chī , kě shì méi yǒu tú shū guǎn ān jìng .
lines.en: I have visited the nearby restaurant once. The food is good, but it is not as quiet as the library.

lines.zh: 今天雨很大，地上有水，外面的地不干。
lines.py: jīn tiān yǔ hěn dà , dì shang yǒu shuǐ , wài miàn de dì bù gàn .
lines.en: There is heavy rain today; water is on the ground and the ground outside is not dry.

lines.zh: 走路比坐车慢，所以我们先坐车到商店。
lines.py: zǒu lù bǐ zuò chē màn , suǒ yǐ wǒ men xiān zuò chē dào shāng diàn .
lines.en: Walking is slower than taking a vehicle, so we will go to the shop by vehicle first.

lines.zh: 我很渴，在商店买水，再去读书。
lines.py: wǒ hěn kě , zài shāng diàn mǎi shuǐ , zài qù dú shū .
lines.en: I am thirsty; I will buy water at the shop, then go and read.

lines.zh: 朋友生病请假了，今天在家休息，不等她。
lines.py: péng you shēng bìng qǐng jià le , jīn tiān zài jiā xiū xī , bù děng tā .
lines.en: Our friend is ill and took leave; she is resting at home today, so we will not wait for her.

lines.zh: 学校明天放假，今天图书馆开门，我们今天去。
lines.py: xué xiào míng tiān fàng jià , jīn tiān tú shū guǎn kāi mén , wǒ men jīn tiān qù .
lines.en: The school has a holiday tomorrow; the library is open today, so we will go today.

choices: It is quiet and known to be open today
questions.answer: It is quiet and known to be open today

choices: She is ill and took leave
She is at the shopping centre
questions.answer: She is ill and took leave

questions.q: Does quietness alone settle every practical choice?
choices: No, transport and opening also matter
